title: Host disk or memory pressure
symptoms: 'Host disk or memory threshold exceeded' messages

steps.title: Identify the hosts under pressure
steps.description: Check disk and memory usage on the hosts named in the errors and compare with healthy hosts.

steps.title: Free disk space by rotating or clearing old logs and temp files
steps.description: Remove rotated logs, core dumps and temp files on the affected hosts.

steps.title: Drain and restart the affected host
steps.description: Remove the host from the load balancer, restart the service, then re-add it.

steps.title: Scale out the service
steps.description: Add capacity so load is spread away from constrained hosts.

escalation: Platform on-call if more than one host is affected.
